title: The idea of Tollgate in four steps
desc: First the tests are written; they say what done means. Then they are locked on GitHub, out of the AI's reach. The AI builds, and may try again, but cannot move the goal. The locked tests decide, and only a pass goes in.

nodes.text:
Write the tests
They say what
done means

Lock them
On GitHub, out
of the AI's reach

The AI builds
It may try again.
The goal stays put.

The tests decide
Only a pass
goes in
